svg.text: Inventory Management System - UML Class Diagram (Week 10)
Notation: solid line + hollow triangle = inheritance (generalisation) | dashed line + hollow triangle = interface realisation | solid line + open arrow = association
hollow diamond = aggregation | filled diamond = composition | «abstract» / italics = abstract class or method | underlined = class-level (static) member | - private + public
Types: String, Integer, Real, Boolean, void = no return value, Dictionary = key/value map | [0..*] = zero or more | [0..1] = optional (zero or one)
